name: Vaal Catalysing Infuser
description:
Improves the quality of a ring or amulet,
exceeding maximum quality by up to 10% with a chance of Corrupting it
directions: Right click this item then left click a ring or amulet to apply it. Can only be used on items at or above maximum quality.
consoleDirections: X to use, then A on a ring or amulet to apply it. Can only be used on items at or above maximum quality.
